pages.text: The undead champion of a forgotten war, risen to stand guard over you.$(br2)Summoned with a $(l:rituals/necroturgy_ritual)Necroturgy Ritual$(): an Essence of Eventide on the altar, with a Skeleton Skull, the Draugr, a Shield and a Bone.$(br2)$(italic)Requires Marium's Soulslike Weaponry.$()

pages.title: As a Servant
pages.text: It fights with its whole shield-and-sword art, and enters its second phase at half its health.$(br2)Unlike the boss, it is not slowed or weakened under the open sky.
When it falls, it leaves its soul behind. On a Dark Altar it rises again for 500 souls.
